name: tpl-response-1-nogoal~p1
task: At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door, you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task states a rule only — whenever the ball is out of the way, the key must be carried then or picked up later — which is exactly Response(blocker_moved, has_door_key) hard. blocker_moved is a condition, not a goal, so no Existence is needed and the rule-only warning is valid.

texts: Whenever blocker_moved holds, has_door_key must hold at or after that moment.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key) -> u1
(u1, has_door_key) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, has_door_key, u0) -> 1
